sources.title: IFM/K2-Horizon-7B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: K2-Horizon is an open-weight IFM model family built for transparent foundation-model research, staged checkpoint analysis, and practical deployment. The series spans compact dense models such as K2-Horizon-7B for local experimentation, dense mid-size and large models for high-quality research workloads, and mixture-of-expert (MoE) models for higher-capacity serving.

sources.snippet: Abu Dhabi, UAE, September 3, 2026 — The Institute of Foundation Models (IFM) today introduced K2 Horizon, a new fleet of six AI foundation models ranging from 0.9 billion to 375 billion parameters.
